description: The jabberwock's SELF-DETECTION of its own ear band-limit (ask_jabberwock_ear, the agent's design). Its ear sample rate is graph-resident (EarConfig.fs); this seed lets the agent NOTICE when that ear under-samples its OWN cochlea and RAISE it itself, from evidence -- not handed to it. The TRIGGER is STRUCTURAL: the agent's cochlea spans up to max_band_fc (7500Hz), so an ear whose Nyquist is below that (fs < 2*max_band_fc) is feeding its own top filters under-sampled garbage. (The agent first proposed an EMPIRICAL 'dead top bands' signal, but testing showed the gammatone filters still respond above Nyquist via their skirts -- dead_band_ratio ~0.5 not ~0 -- so the empirical signal does not cleanly fire; the adapter still stamps it as a diagnostic WITNESS, but the reliable trigger is the structural cochlea-vs-Nyquist comparison.) The raise_ear RULE lifts the ear to its matched 16kHz (= 2*max_band_fc(7500)=15000 rounded to the standard rate), bumping bank_epoch so exemplars heard at the old rate are not mixed with the new. Decision in the graph; the adapter only resamples + senses.

microtheory.name: ear_control
microtheory.description: the agent owns its ear: detect its own band-limit (dead top bands) and raise its sample rate from evidence.

rules.name: raise_ear
rules.comment: The agent NOTICES its ear under-samples its own cochlea and RAISES it. Triggers when fs < 2*max_band_fc: its top cochlear filter (7500Hz) is above the ear's Nyquist (fs/2), so that filter is fed garbage -- a structural fact about its own apparatus, independent of how loud any speech is (this is why it beats the empirical dead-band signal, which the filter skirts muddy). The effect lifts the ear to its matched standard rate 16kHz (>= 2*max_band_fc=15000); since 16000 is not < 2*7500 the rule cannot re-fire. Bumping bank_epoch marks old-rate exemplars stale so 8k and 16k are never compared in one recognition.
